description: Delete a custom Blox action from the Sisense instance.

action_type.description: The ``type`` identifier of the Blox action to delete.

examples.user_query: Remove the custom Blox action called 'export_to_csv' from my Sisense instance.
examples.notes: This call deletes the 'export_to_csv' custom Blox action from the Sisense instance. Use this when the action is no longer needed or requires replacement.

examples.user_query: I need to delete the 'send_email_notification' Blox action. How do I do that?
examples.notes: This call removes the 'send_email_notification' custom Blox action. Use this to clean up unused or outdated actions.

examples.user_query: Can I delete the 'generate_pdf_report' action from Sisense?
examples.notes: This call deletes the 'generate_pdf_report' custom Blox action. Use this when the action is no longer relevant or needs to be replaced.

description: Retrieve all custom Blox actions from the Sisense instance.

examples.user_query: List the custom Blox actions available in my Sisense instance.
examples.notes: This call retrieves all custom Blox actions configured in the Sisense instance. Use this to review available actions for dashboards or widgets.

examples.user_query: Can you list all the custom actions defined for Blox?
examples.notes: This call fetches a list of all custom Blox actions. Useful for administrators managing Blox configurations.

examples.user_query: Show me the custom Blox actions I can use for my widgets.
examples.notes: This call provides a list of custom Blox actions that can be applied to widgets or dashboards in Sisense.

description: Save a custom Blox action on the Sisense instance.

examples.user_query: Save a custom Blox action named 'ExportDashboardAction' that exports dashboard dashboard_12345 to PDF.
examples.notes: This saves a custom action that allows exporting a specific dashboard to PDF format.

examples.user_query: I want to create a custom action that triggers a webhook when a widget is updated. How do I do that?
examples.notes: This creates a custom action that triggers a POST request to a specified webhook URL whenever the specified widget is updated.

examples.user_query: Can I define a custom action to send an email notification when a data alert is triggered?

payload.subject: Data Alert Triggered
payload.body: The data alert has been triggered. Please review the details.

examples.notes: This defines a custom action that sends an email notification to specified recipients when a specific data alert is triggered.
